documents.title: About Helio Airways
documents.text: Helio Airways is a regional carrier based in Lisbon, flying 34 aircraft on short-haul routes across southern Europe. The airline was founded in 2011 and carries about 9 million passengers a year.

documents.title: Helio Airways names new CIO
documents.text: Helio Airways appointed Marta Ferreira as Chief Information Officer on 2026-08-25. Ferreira arrives from a European rail operator and will lead a three-year systems modernisation. The role reports directly to the chief executive.

documents.title: Helio launches self-service rebooking
documents.text: Helio Airways launched a self-service rebooking app for disrupted passengers on 2026-09-01. The airline said the app handles delays, cancellations and seat changes without a call centre agent.

documents.title: Technology at Helio Airways
documents.text: Helio Airways runs on an Amadeus passenger service system, with a cloud data warehouse for operations reporting. Engineering work is split between Lisbon and Porto.
